logp.method_description: To determine the partition coefficient (P) the shake flask method was used. 1-Octanol-saturated water (OSW) and water-saturated 1-octanol (WSO) were prepared using analytical grade 1-octanol and 0.2 M aqueous NaCl solution (to suppress hydrolysis of the chlorido complexes). Mixing was done by vortexing for 30 min at room temperature to establish the partition equilibrium. To separate the phases, centrifugation was done at 3000 g for 5 min. The aqueous layer was carefully separated from the 1-octanol layer for platinum analysis. Pt was quantified from aliquots taken from the 1-octanol-saturated aqueous samples before and after partition by FAAS. Partition coefficients of Pt complexes were calculated using the equation log P = log([Pt]WSO / [Pt]OSW).
